request.project_task: Build a visitor parking permit request service.
request.project_goal: Issue time-limited visitor permits without a paper form.
request.project_description: A resident requests a permit for a visitor vehicle and security verifies it.

functional_requirements.text: A resident submits the visitor vehicle plate and visit time.

atoms.text: A resident submits the visitor vehicle plate and visit time.

functional_requirements.text: The system issues a permit when the request is complete.

atoms.text: The system issues a permit when the request is complete.

functional_requirements.text: Security can verify an active permit by plate number.

atoms.text: Security can verify an active permit by plate number.

non_functional_requirements.text: Permit lookup must complete within two seconds.

actors.description: The automated system that issues and stores permits.

use_cases.name: Request Visitor Parking Permit
use_cases.goal: A resident submits a visitor vehicle plate and visit time so the system can issue a time-limited permit.
use_cases.trigger: Resident decides to request a visitor parking permit.

preconditions.text: Resident has access to the ParkPass service.

success_postconditions.text: A time-limited visitor parking permit is issued and stored for the submitted plate and visit time.

failure_postconditions.text: No permit is issued and the resident is informed that the request is incomplete.

main_success_scenario.name: Resident submits complete request and permit is issued

steps.action: Resident submits the visitor vehicle plate and visit time.
steps.expected_result: The system receives the plate and visit time.

steps.action: System validates that the request is complete.
System issues a time-limited visitor parking permit.
steps.expected_result: A permit is issued and stored for the submitted plate and visit time.

steps.action: Resident submits a request missing the visitor vehicle plate or visit time.
steps.expected_result: The system detects that the request is incomplete.

steps.action: System does not issue a permit and informs the resident that the request is incomplete.
steps.expected_result: No permit is issued; the resident is notified.

user_stories.capability: submit a visitor vehicle plate and visit time
user_stories.benefit: I can obtain a time-limited visitor parking permit without a paper form.

system_stories.system_action: Validate that the submitted visitor vehicle plate and visit time are present and complete.
system_stories.responsibility: Ensure only complete requests proceed to permit issuance.

system_stories.system_action: Issue and store a time-limited visitor parking permit for the submitted plate and visit time.
system_stories.responsibility: Create the permit record that security can later verify.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-001 — Request Visitor Parking Permit
Goal: A resident submits a visitor vehicle plate and visit time so the system can issue a time-limited permit.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Resident decides to request a visitor parking permit.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC001-001: Resident has access to the ParkPass service.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC001-001] Resident submits the visitor vehicle plate and visit time.
  2. [STEP-UC001-002] System validates that the request is complete.
  3. [STEP-UC001-003] System issues a time-limited visitor parking permit.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC001-EXC-001: Incomplete request
Source FRs: FR-001, FR-002

use_cases.name: Verify Active Visitor Parking Permit
use_cases.goal: Security verifies that an active permit exists for a given vehicle plate number.
use_cases.trigger: Security needs to check whether a visitor vehicle has an active parking permit.

preconditions.text: Security has access to the ParkPass verification function.

success_postconditions.text: Security is shown whether an active permit exists for the plate number.

failure_postconditions.text: Security is informed that no active permit was found for the plate number.

main_success_scenario.name: Security verifies an active permit by plate number

steps.action: Security enters the visitor vehicle plate number to verify.
steps.expected_result: The system receives the plate number.

steps.action: System looks up an active permit for the plate number.
steps.expected_result: The lookup completes within two seconds.

steps.action: System displays the active permit status for the plate number.
steps.expected_result: Security sees that an active permit exists.

steps.action: Security enters a plate number that has no active permit.
steps.expected_result: The system receives the plate number.

steps.action: System finds no active permit for the plate number.
steps.expected_result: The lookup completes within two seconds.

steps.action: System informs Security that no active permit was found.
steps.expected_result: Security sees that no active permit exists.

user_stories.capability: verify an active permit by plate number
user_stories.benefit: I can confirm whether a visitor vehicle is authorized to park.

system_stories.system_action: Look up an active permit by plate number within two seconds.
system_stories.responsibility: Provide fast and accurate permit verification for security.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-002 — Verify Active Visitor Parking Permit
Goal: Security verifies that an active permit exists for a given vehicle plate number.
Primary actor: ACT-002
Trigger: Security needs to check whether a visitor vehicle has an active parking permit.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC002-001: Security has access to the ParkPass verification function.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC002-001] Security enters the visitor vehicle plate number to verify.
  2. [STEP-UC002-002] System looks up an active permit for the plate number.
  3. [STEP-UC002-003] System displays the active permit status for the plate number.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC002-EXC-001: No active permit found
Source FRs: FR-003

issues.message: Edge ADE-UC001-001 must link to UC step(s) or be marked unsupported

details.summary: The activity diagram faithfully represents the UC-001 main success scenario and the incomplete-request exception. All UC steps (STEP-UC001-001 through STEP-UC001-005) are mapped to activities or decision nodes, the decision on request completeness correctly branches to permit issuance or the no-permit notification, and both branches terminate at the final node. No unsupported business actions or step-level contradictions are present.

issues.message: Edge ADE-UC002-001 must link to UC step(s) or be marked unsupported

The exception scenario's step STEP-UC002-004 (Security enters a plate number with no active permit) is not represented as a separate activity node; the diagram models the no-permit outcome via the decision node ADN-UC002-004 and the 'no' branch. This is an equivalent control-flow decomposition and does not omit or contradict any UC step.

details.summary: The activity diagram preserves the main success scenario (enter plate, lookup, display status) and the exception outcome (no active permit found) with correct actor partitions and ordering. The decision node cleanly separates the success and failure branches. No UC step is omitted or contradicted, and no unsupported business action is added. Accept.
